description: A mezzanine of housewares reached by an escalator that gave up years ago and is now just stairs with opinions. Plates in stacks, kettles in rows, a display bed made up with sheets the colour of weak tea. Someone has arranged a whole fake dining room up here, table laid, chairs pushed in, a vase of plastic stems, and people come up just to stand near it.
name: Adequate! — Housewares
